findings.issue: The only negative is וְלֹא on תָמֻתוּ (you shall not die). The next clause, וְעַל כָּל־הָעֵדָה יִקְצֹף, has no negative: he will be angry upon all the congregation. Spanish negates that verb.
כל־בית ישראל is the whole house of Israel (construct plus the proper name). “toda casa” can be read as every house.

notes: 2mp address as ustedes (sus cabezas, desmelenen, rasguen, morirán) keeps the same addressees.
